Titel: Head of HR Transformation (m/w/d)
Unternehmen: Rheinhafen Armaturen GmbH
Ort: Düsseldorf, Nordrhein-Westfalen, Deutschland
Quelle: LinkedIn

110.000 €/Jahr - 130.000 €/Jahr
Hybrid · Vollzeit · Direktor

About the job
Rheinhafen Armaturen is a family-owned manufacturer of industrial valves with 2,400 employees at nine sites in Germany, Poland and Mexico. Our HR function is still organised site by site. We want to change that and are looking for a permanent Head of HR Transformation who reports directly to the CHRO.

Your mission
Design and roll out a new HR operating model (HR business partners, centres of expertise, shared services)
Lead the harmonisation of HR processes across all German sites, including the works council consultations
Own the selection and implementation of a cloud HR suite (core HR, payroll interface, recruiting)
Build a people analytics baseline and a monthly HR reporting for the executive board
Manage a transformation team of four and an external implementation partner
Drive change management and communication together with the site managers

What you bring
University degree in business administration, psychology or a comparable field
At least 10 years of HR experience, of which at least 5 in leading HR transformation or HR IT programmes
Proven track record in setting up HR shared services in a manufacturing environment
Experience working with works councils and co-determination (BetrVG)
Solid project management skills (classic and agile)
Fluent German and English; Polish or Spanish is a plus

What we offer
Permanent contract with a target salary of 110,000 to 130,000 EUR plus annual bonus
Company car or mobility budget
Up to 3 days mobile work per week, on site in Düsseldorf-Reisholz on the other days
30 days of vacation, company pension scheme, bike leasing

Interested? Apply via LinkedIn with your CV. We process applications within two weeks.
